detailed_findings.title: Environmental and social policy
detailed_findings.rationale: Strong written policy in place, signed by General Manager. Covers environmental conservation, cultural preservation, and community engagement.

detailed_findings.title: Environmental management plan
detailed_findings.rationale: Comprehensive plan updated annually. Covers water, energy, waste, biodiversity, and community impacts. Implementation tracked quarterly.

detailed_findings.title: Monitoring and evaluation
detailed_findings.rationale: Monitoring system in place but data collection incomplete for some metrics. Monthly data for energy and water only.

detailed_findings.title: Water consumption
detailed_findings.rationale: Meters installed and consumption tracked monthly. Current: 312 cubic meters per guest per year (target: 280).

detailed_findings.title: Water sources
detailed_findings.rationale: Water sourced from municipal supply confirmed sustainable by local water authority.

detailed_findings.title: Waste reduction
detailed_findings.rationale: Basic waste segregation in place but no formal reduction targets. 45 percent currently to landfill.

detailed_findings.title: Staff wellbeing
detailed_findings.rationale: Training program covers sustainability and safety. 96 percent annual completion rate. Staff satisfaction 4.2/5.
